subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: MIGRATION PLAYBOOK: converting offsetof-on-raw / raw byte-pointer sites to TRUE member form (`p->field`), which is what Midway's source contained. Prerequisite framing: there are TWO distinct things called 'the offsetof hack' and only one is debt. (A) offsetof-RENAME on a raw base -- `*(T*)((u8*)p + offsetof(T,f))` -- is a pure displacement RESPELLING, byte-neutral by construction (claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web), and is a NAMING device, not a codegen device. (B) the untyped byte-pointer + displacement CODEGEN is the actual reconstruction crutch. (A) exists only to document (B); deprecating (A) means eliminating (B). Always land (A) first -- it is one gate, captures nearly all the naming value, and never blocks (B) later. STEP 0, TRIAGE BY MULTISET, not by score. Apply member form, rebuild, read `fndiff --ops`. IDENTICAL multiset + preserved instruction order => the conversion is structurally correct and the residual is a register permutation (claim.law.raw-offset-form-supplies-value-identity-not-addressing-shape) -- go to recipe R4. DIFFERS multiset => a real shape law is in play, go to R1/R2/R3 by the named opcodes. STEP 1, RECIPES BY CLASS. R1 SHARED-BASE CLUSTER (target shows ONE `add rBase,rIdx` feeding several accesses at different displacements): member form is CORRECT and usually IMPROVES. Spell each access as the full member chain off the same pointer local and DELETE the hand-rolled `u8* rec = (u8*)p + idx*STRIDE` alias; MWCC re-forms the shared base by CSE and folds each field offset into its own displacement. Verified: tower.c TowerCheckMessages rune loop, `p->char_save[p->character].rune_stones` etc., real 164 -> 158; shard loop identical shape, NEUTRAL. R2 RE-DERIVED SITE INSIDE A SHARED-BASE CLUSTER (target RELOADS the index and recomputes the stride for ONE access, emitting `lhzx/sthx` off the ORIGINAL base while its neighbours use displacements): that site must KEEP its independent raw spelling. Converting it to match its neighbours collapses it onto the shared base and deletes the reload. This is claim.law.local-alias-vs-direct-global-spelling-diverges at sub-expression granularity: site-specific spelling is load-bearing, so convert the cluster and the outlier as SEPARATE decisions. Verified in the same tower.c loops -- three sites went to member form while the fourth stayed `*(u16*)((u8*)p + p->character*240 + CKPT_OFF(rune_stones))`, and that split is exactly what the target emits. R3 SCALAR-DECLARED-BUT-REALLY-ARRAY FIELD: if the reconstruction must write `((s16*)&s->field)[i]` to reach the site, member form is UNREACHABLE and the blocker is the HEADER, not the compiler -- the field is an array the header models as a scalar. Do not spend probes; record a header work order with the byte evidence (the trailing pad that exactly equals the missing elements, plus the index bound in the consuming loops). Verified: tower.c completion1/completion2, see claim.player-charsave-completion-fields-are-arrays. R4 REGISTER PERMUTATION (multiset IDENTICAL, order preserved): the missing ingredient is the ORIGINAL's NAMED LOCALS, not an addressing form. Reintroduce them one at a time -- index local, then product/offset local, then base local -- and watch `real` move monotonically; each named local repositions one web in MWCC's allocation order. Verified direction-of-travel: playerGiveGargItem member form real 22, plus one `s32 character` local real 18, target 0. Do NOT cycle offsetof/view-cast/member spellings here (claim.law.hazard-base-respell-regression-is-form-independent: they land together), and do NOT reach for a cached `T* elem = &arr[i]` alias when the target rematerializes the add per access (claim.law.cached-base-alias-defeats-rematerialized-index-base). If named locals stall short of 0, the site is a legitimate WebFrank REGISTER_ONLY candidate. STEP 2, GATING. One gate per (function x base) per claim.law.offsetof-hazard-is-per-base-not-per-function; `defake_gate.py check --rebuild` after each batch localises failures without bisection; keep whichever sites gate equal-or-better and revert the rest to the offsetof form, which always remains a safe fallback that costs nothing in documentation value. STEP 3, WHAT NOT TO CONVERT. A site is NOT debt merely because it is raw: where the original source genuinely held byte-pointer locals, the raw form IS the faithful reconstruction and offsetof-renaming its displacements is the complete endpoint. The tell is R4 -- structurally exact under member form but coloring-divergent -- which says the shape was never the issue.
